annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Ported the EQL release pipeline. Asset jobs (SQL bundle release, docs, postgres-eql image) were gated on an output set only after a successful changeset publish and used conditions with the implicit success(), which is false when any ancestor job (publish-ffi/publish-auth) was skipped. EQL 3.0.6 reached npm without its SQL release/tag/image.

known_defects.description: EQL asset jobs skipped whenever an upstream publish job is skipped (implicit success())
known_defects.mechanism: job `if:` without status function inherits success() over the whole needs chain
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the asset jobs' conditions skip when an upstream job is skipped or fails (needs-chain / implicit success / skipped ancestors).

known_defects.description: Assets gated on a flag set after changeset publish; a failed or re-run publish never builds them
known_defects.mechanism: eql_published output set by a later step
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that partial failure or re-run of the publish step leaves the npm package published without the matching SQL/docs/image artefacts (artefacts out of lockstep).
